info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Cloud Dataplex API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Lakes, zones, assets, entry groups, entry types and aspect types are configuration metadata (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog): no bucket, dataset, metastore or entry is read, created or published, and lakes, zones and assets report ACTIVE immediately. Discovery, data scans, tasks and metadata jobs never run; asset resource references are not resolved and zone IDs are unique only within their lake. Delete zones before their lake and assets before their zone, as Dataplex requires. Entries, entry links, glossaries, data products and taxonomies are unimplemented.
info.title: Knowledge Catalog (simulator catalog)
